summary: Repair intermittent remote-provider TLS unexpected EOF after macOS proxy/TUN transitions by refreshing only the failed retry's transport; preserve bounded retries, concurrent callers, cancellation and response integrity.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing LLMClient and ModelClientPool provider transport lifecycle
components.disposition: Reuse the existing provider retry budget and retirement callback. On a permitted retry following ConnectError, ConnectTimeout or explicit TLS UNEXPECTED_EOF, create one attempt-local httpx.Client using the existing trust_env, timeout and Connection policy. Close only that temporary client; do not close a shared client used by concurrent callers. All other retry paths retain the original transport. Preserve identical payload, request budget, cancellation and partial-output safety.
evidence: Mac Web and Learning logs on 2026-11-23 show recurring TLS unexpected EOF across GLM and DeepSeek. Both Surge and Clash were present during the incident; proxy/TUN switching is suspected, not conclusively proven as the sole root cause.

Exact candidate f655ef6d338884c7ee3b62aa2e18e2520e06f266 passed the original full R9 with exit 0: 16542 passed, 162 skipped, 3 xfailed; Ruff, env-pin and Pyright passed. Host-local receipts: /private/var/tmp/lfl-ssl-eof-r9-f655ef-recheck.log and .exit.

Independent read-only GLM-5.3-flash reviewer observed model identity glm-5.3-flash and returned PASS, P0=0, P1=0, P2=4 for candidate f655ef6d338884c7ee3b62aa2e18e2520e06f266. Host-local receipt: /private/var/tmp/lfl-ssl-eof-review-f655ef.json. The new manifest commit changes SHA and must be requalified before merging.
components.verification_level: Isolated deterministic regression and full original R9 passed for code-only candidate; manifest-only new SHA, remote CI, production real-provider tests and managed deployment remain pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: No retry after user cancellation, stream deadline, delivered response content, tool draft or unsafe partial output. Retain the existing bounded reasoning-only exception and physical-attempt accounting. A failed retry returns a truthful network/stream error, not a fabricated answer or claim of Key/model misconfiguration. A reviewer or test receipt for a different SHA is not accepted as the final candidate.
components.rollback_route: Revert the protected SSL recovery PR, restoring the prior LLMClient retry transport and feedback behavior; preserve existing ModelClientPool retirement and the previous managed deployment for rollback.

g1.necessity: After proxy/TUN changes, an in-flight TLS connection may close unexpectedly. Retiring a pooled client only helps the next logical call; the already-admitted retry could reuse the same stale client, repeatedly failing despite an available fresh connection.

g2.authority_owner: Existing LLMClient transport attempt scope, ModelClientPool on_transport_failure retirement hook, TaskBudget physical-attempt gate and cancellation policy.
g2.non_duplication: No new signer, proxy manager, global network configuration, retry authority, background worker, service controller or model fallback. Only an attempt-local transport refresh on an already permitted retry; existing owner, task and provider constraints remain authoritative.

model_evidence: Independent GLM-5.3-flash code review of frozen code-only SHA f655ef6d338884c7ee3b62aa2e18e2520e06f266: PASS, P0/P1=0, P2=4.
Original full R9 on that exact code-only SHA: exit 0, 16542 passed, 162 skipped, 3 xfailed; targeted retry, provider wire integrity, cancellation and error-feedback tests included.
The proxy/TUN correlation is supported by incident logs and DNS routing observations, but a single external root cause is not independently proven.
g3.recovery_or_reason: If a connection or TLS error occurs, refresh only when the existing retry budget and partial-output/cancellation guards permit it; otherwise fail closed with an accurate network error and no duplicated side effects.

g4.rollback: Revert this exact small PR or roll back the managed service deployment to the previously verified generation; do not change system proxy settings or remove other in-progress PRs.
